summary: Three kayaks capsized in high winds (gusts 35-51 mph) Sunday afternoon at Lake Pueblo State Park: a kayak carrying an adult and a toddler overturned, and two other kayakers who rushed to help also ended up in the water; 911 call ~3:23 p.m.; a CPW ranger pulled the toddler from the water, performed CPR, and the child was airlifted ~20 miles north to a Colorado Springs hospital; one adult was found deceased in the water and the second adult was located hours later by an underwater drone in ~20 ft of water (water too rough for a traditional search)
notes: Incident date = the Sunday before the 2022-10-24 article; seventh and eighth Lake Pueblo water deaths of 2022
